summary: This document describes the `PlacementHistory` user control in the HSPnet system, which handles viewing and interacting with a supervisor's placement history. It includes user interface elements, data handling, and actions for managing placement data.
purpose: The `PlacementHistory` control is used to view and manage the historical data related to supervisor placements, including the ability to print reports and handle user interactions.

fields.name: StaffID
fields.description: The ID of the staff member whose placement history is being viewed.

fields.name: ScreenIsEditable
fields.description: Indicates whether the screen is editable.

fields.name: SortExpression
fields.description: The sort expression for ordering data.

fields.name: PRHistoryOnly
fields.description: Determines whether to show only placement report history.

fields.name: AlternateObservation
fields.description: Indicates if there is an alternate observation.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the PlacementHistory control to view and manage placement reports.

workflows.name: View and Manage Placement History
steps: Check if only the report history view is required.
Bind data to the repeater control.
Handle various command actions such as sorting or showing details.
Print the report if required by the user.

business_rules: If PRHistoryOnly is true, certain UI elements are hidden.
Only allow details view if the PR_ID is greater than zero and conditions are editable.
validations: Check if UserSession is not null before proceeding with actions.
Ensure PR_ID is greater than zero for certain UI elements to be visible.
conditions: Visibility of UI elements based on the UserSession and editable state.
system_behavior: The system toggles css classes for detail buttons based on whether entries are archived.
dependencies: It relies on HSPnet session management, user interface controls, and data handling components.
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
